notes: The prompt calls itself a horror survival game and splits players into Hunters and Runners, which is the asymmetric-roles case the 1 vs All preset is for. The shape is the looping warren because the whole game is a chase through a dark building of rooms, corridors and doors, and a cornered dead end would decide the round unfairly, so its P6 stands and is not negotiable. I dropped gate-escape from the preset: the answers say Runners win by outlasting the timer, so there is no exit to reach, and I left building-interior off because the answer makes the map a single compact building complex rather than an outdoor map with shelters to duck into, so nothing crosses an outside-inside boundary and no P3 is earned. With no user to ask, I treated the interactive lobby as staging outside the play space and let spawn-protected carry the separated Hunter and Runner starts; the final-minute darkening and Hunter glow are lighting and effects rather than layout.
